2609.02095.title: READY or Not: Reliable Enterprise Agent Deployment
2609.02095.paper_summary: An AI agent can perform well on benchmarks and still be unsuitable for deployment. Existing AI-agent benchmarks measure whether an agent can complete realistic professional work, whereas enterprise deployment asks a different question: whether an agent can meet a required reliability level, under acceptable human oversight, and at tolerable cost. We introduce Reliable Enterprise Agent Deployment (READY), a framework for qualifying AI agents for deployment on enterprise workflows. READY preserves each workflow's own definition of successful execution while applying a common qualification procedure. Given an agent, a workflow, and a class of candidate oversight policies, READY measures the reliability and operating cost of the human-AI system, selects the minimum-cost policy that satisfies a specified reliability target, and statistically qualifies it on held-out cases. The resulting deployment profile characterizes the supported operating point: reliability, human-oversight burden, and cost. READY is implemented as an open testbed that decouples workflow specification, execution, evaluation, and qualification, and runs on existing agent-evaluation infrastructure. In an end-to-end clinical-audit case study spanning 16 agent systems and 750 cases, READY reveals differences hidden by autonomous performance: two systems separated by only 0.3 points in autonomous accuracy (72.8% vs. 72.5%) require 39.2% versus 29.6% human review, respectively, to qualify at the same 76% reliability target under the evaluated oversight policy. READY thus shifts enterprise agent evaluation from how well can the agent perform the work? to under what conditions, and at what cost, can it be reliably deployed? By making those conditions explicit and statistically testable, READY provides a basis for comparing agent systems, setting oversight requirements, and making evidence-based deployment decisions.
2609.02095.paper_summary_zh: 一個 AI 代理可以在基準測試中表現良好，但仍然不適合部署。現有的 AI 代理基準測試衡量代理是否能完成現實的專業工作，而企業部署則提出了不同的問題：代理是否能在可接受的人類監督下，滿足所需的可靠性水平，並在可容忍的成本內。我們引入了可靠企業代理部署（READY），這是一個用於為企業工作流程資格認證 AI 代理的框架。READY 保留每個工作流程對成功執行的自我定義，同時應用共同的資格認證程序。給定一個代理、一個工作流程和一類候選監督政策，READY 測量人類-AI 系統的可靠性和運營成本，選擇滿足指定可靠性目標的最低成本政策，並在保留的案例上進行統計資格認證。結果的部署配置描述了支持的運營點：可靠性、人類監督負擔和成本。READY 實現為一個開放的測試平台，將工作流程規範、執行、評估和資格認證解耦，並在現有的代理評估基礎設施上運行。在一個涵蓋 16 個代理系統和 750 個案例的端到端臨床審核案例研究中，READY 揭示了自主性能隱藏的差異：兩個系統在自主準確性上僅相差 0.3 分（72.8% 對 72.5%），但在評估的監督政策下，分別需要 39.2% 和 29.6% 的人類審查，以在同一 76% 的可靠性目標下獲得資格。因此，READY 將企業代理評估的重點從代理能多好地執行工作？轉變為在什麼條件下，並以什麼成本，可以可靠地部署？通過使這些條件明確且可統計測試，READY 為比較代理系統、設置監督要求和做出基於證據的部署決策提供了基礎。
